content_html:
Legal • Openink Hub

Nothing to ship, everything to deploy.

Openink Hub delivers SEO, GMB automation, AI agents, and WhatsApp Business API tools — all digital, all SaaS. There's no physical shipping here, but there is a clear standard for how fast and how reliably we get your access live.

Effective date

14 July 2026

Website

openinkhub.io

Contact

info@openinkhub.io

Section 1

Digital delivery & access

Every product, service, and license purchased on openinkhub.io is delivered digitally — no couriers involved.

SaaS & automation tools

Live within 24–48 hours

Access to platforms like GMB automation, the WhatsApp API, or SEO workflow dashboards is provisioned automatically, or within 24 to 48 hours of confirmed payment. Login details go straight to your registered email.

Custom deliverables

Per your service agreement

For bespoke SEO, AEO/AIO/GEO campaigns, and social media management, timelines, milestones, and reports are delivered electronically by email or through our client portal, following the schedule in your service agreement.

Section 2

Timelines & deployment

01

Standard onboarding

Once payment clears, our team kicks off onboarding, and you'll hear from us with an initial setup communication within 1–2 business days.

02

Integration & API setup

Third-party integrations such as WhatsApp API registration depend on approval timelines from providers like Meta. We're not liable for delays on their end, though we'll help you through the process every step of the way.

03

Custom deliverables

Custom digital content, strategy reports, or configuration work follows the specific roadmap laid out in your business proposal.

Section 3

If delivery doesn't go as planned

Because delivery is electronic, most hiccups come down to communication or access barriers rather than logistics.

  • Delivery counts as complete once access credentials are generated and emailed, or agreed campaign reports are sent.
  • Please make sure your email server accepts mail from info@openinkhub.io and check your spam folder.
  • No credentials after 48 hours? Contact +91 9204135136 or info@openinkhub.io for manual provisioning.
  • Timely input, brand assets, and approvals from your side keep custom setups (SEO audits, GMB optimization, chatbot flows) on schedule.

Section 4

Suspension & refund cross-reference

Right of refusal

When access can be paused

We may suspend digital delivery, pause campaigns, or revoke platform access for non-payment, or for policy violations such as spamming through the WhatsApp API.

Refunds & cancellations

Covered separately

Since our services are digital and resource-intensive from day one, all purchases follow our dedicated Refund & Cancellation Policy — please review that page for your rights around cancellations and refunds.

Section 5

Questions about your delivery?

Reach out and we'll help get your access sorted.

Email

info@openinkhub.io

Phone / WhatsApp

+91 9204135136
